corpusValidation.method: L1 integer income ledger (startMoney − moneySpent reconstruction) + L4 replay-native cash-transition ledger (8 Hz replay money stream, per-transition event attribution)

results.L1: summary-ledger exact reconciliation rate 91.0% (202 replay 90.6%) — method limitation, NOT rule accuracy
results.L1-nonzero-decomp: 3653/3653 replay-explained (summaryFieldLimitation: buy-window purchase/refund absent from moneySpent snapshot); 887 noReplay; 0 real unexplained; 0 sampling ambiguous
results.L4: 85,599 cash transitions, 100.0% explained (69.6% exact + 30.4% compound); $0 unexplained; 8 Hz aliasing fully decomposable
results.L3: time_ran_out T survivor: 354 samples, 0 loss-payout violations
results.OT: 84 OT halves: 42 reset to 10000 (mp_overtime_startmoney), 42 carry-over — server/match profile, 12500 not observed

notes.lossBonusRule: mp_starting_losses=1 → half starts count 1; loss +1 (cap 4); win decrement UNRESOLVED (corpus: payout-tier drop 1 across any win; candidate internal decrement 2 under documented update order; cap decrement runtime-unverified — see docs/experiments/loss-counter-runtime.md)
notes.buytime: mp_buytime 20 counts from freeze end (H2): buys observed at freezeEnd+19.6s; exact close unverified (controlled test pending)
notes.moneySpent: snapshot of native m_iCashSpentThisRound at round_freeze_end; excludes post-freeze buys/refunds; sellback semantics unresolved
notes.pricesSource: weapon prices from generated weapons.v2026-08-06.json (GameTracking-CS2 2e606a0b, incl. bizon 1300 2026 drop); non-weapon prices in this file
notes.killRewardUnknown: GSI cannot report kill weapons (capability-matrix §2); real-time path uses class aggregate from weapon table; unknown → explicit error, never 300
